resources.string: Look up the shipment sheet you exported by hand: is a lane loaded, where a plate went, whose vehicle it is, the driver\'s phone. Read-only — no network, no T9 login

Reads today\'s imported shipping sheet from the local \"logistics\" database and answers by lane, drop point, plate, waybill, goods or driver in a fixed three lines: the answer, the numbers, and the data time plus the vehicle-count basis. Driver names and phone numbers show on the local panel only (tap to open the dialer) — never into the model, never into logs. When no sheet has been imported it says so plainly — it never guesses a plate count. Read-only, offline, no credentials. Your question is neither stored nor logged. Hidden by default: unlock the Logistics query group via capabilities first.
Today\'s exported sheet: loaded or not, how many trucks, where each went, whose phone. Offline.
Reads the sheet you exported from T9 by hand and dropped into Products/物流/inbox. This step uses no network and no account.
Not in this sheet: %1$s — those dimensions are hidden, not counted, not flagged
Ask one line, e.g. \"Is Beijing loaded?\" or \"Where did A12345 go?\" or \"Lao Zhang\'s phone\"
Copied: %1$s (long-press a number to copy again)
